About
Minimal Gallery is a curated source of website design inspiration aiming to support people in their creative process. Running since 2013.
The site was originally brought to life as a passion project by
Piet Therheyden
(acquired in 2026).
Seeing the need for a website gallery to help designers with inspiration for client projects, he started building the first version back in early 2013.
Minimal Gallery has since become one of the leading web design galleries, followed by tens of thousands of designers, developers, agencies, marketing specialists and entrepreneurs all over the world.
If you have created or know a beautiful website, template or a useful tool, you're welcome to

1. Introduction
Welcome to minimal.gallery (“we”, “us”, or “the Site”), a curated gallery showcasing websites, design resources, tools, and other digital creations for design inspiration.
By accessing or using the Site, you agree to these Terms and Conditions (which include our Privacy Policy). If you do not agree, please do not use the Site.
2. User Submissions
You may submit websites, templates, tools, or other content through our submission form, including resources you do not own. This form collects personal information such as your
name and email address
, along with the submitted URL and any optional additional information you choose to provide (e.g. credits or comments).
We review all submissions and reserve the right to accept, reject, edit, categorize, or remove any submission at our sole discretion. We create the screenshot/thumbnail and add relevant metadata.
By submitting content, you represent and warrant that:
The URL you submit is publicly accessible and you have a good-faith belief that it is appropriate for inclusion in a design inspiration gallery.
The submission (including any credits, comments, or other information you provide) does not infringe any third-party rights (copyright, trademark, privacy, or other rights).
The submitted website/resource does not contain illegal content, malware, or material that violates applicable laws.
We do not claim ownership of the submitted websites/tools themselves. However, the screenshots, thumbnails, curated descriptions, metadata, and overall presentation on minimal.gallery are our original work and property.
3. Intellectual Property
All content on minimal.gallery — including screenshots, thumbnails, layout, design, text, graphics, and metadata — is owned by us or our licensors and protected by copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.
You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, display, or use any images (screenshots/thumbnails), designs, or other Site content for commercial or public purposes without our prior written permission. This includes scraping, downloading images in bulk, or republishing the gallery on other platforms.
Limited personal use (e.g., viewing and bookmarking for inspiration) is permitted. If you wish to use any image or content, please contact us for permission.
4. Affiliate Links
Some links on this Site may be affiliate links. This means that if you click on certain links and make a purchase, we may earn a small commission at no additional cost to you. These commissions help support the maintenance and growth of minimal.gallery. We only recommend resources we believe are valuable to our visitors.
5. Privacy Policy
5.1 Information We Collect
Submission Form
: Personal information such as your name and email address, the submitted URL, and any other voluntary information you provide.
Newsletter
: Your email address (collected and managed via MailerLite).
Usage Data / Analytics
: We use
Plausible Analytics
, a privacy-friendly and GDPR-compliant service, to collect standard, anonymized usage data such as pages visited, device type, referrer, and general traffic trends. Plausible does not use cookies and does not collect any personal data.
Local Storage & Cookies
: We may use browser local storage and/or cookies to support features such as saving your bookmarked websites. These are stored on your device and are not transmitted to our servers.
5.2 How We Use Your Information
Process and review your submissions.
Contact you regarding your submission (if needed).
Send newsletter updates (only if you subscribed).
Analyze site usage and improve the Site and user experience.
Comply with legal obligations.
5.3 Sharing of Information
We do
not
sell or share your personal information (especially name and email from submissions) with third parties for marketing or unrelated purposes.
Submission data is kept private and used only for operating the Site.
Newsletter emails are processed and stored securely by
MailerLite
(their privacy policy applies:
https://www.mailerlite.com/privacy-policy
).
Website analytics data is processed by
Plausible Analytics
(their privacy policy:
https://plausible.io/privacy
).
We may disclose information if required by law, to protect our rights, or in the event of a business transfer.
5.4 Data Retention
We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described or as required by law. You may request deletion of your personal data by contacting us.
5.5 Your Rights
Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at the email below.
6. Third-Party Services
MailerLite
: Handles newsletter subscriptions. Your data is subject to their privacy practices.
Plausible Analytics
: Provides privacy-friendly website analytics.
Our hosting and other service providers act as processors under our instructions and are obligated to protect your data.
7. Disclaimers & Limitations of Liability
The Site and all content are provided “as is” without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or availability of the showcased websites or our curation.
We are not responsible for the content, security, practices, or products of external websites linked from the Site (including affiliate links).
To the fullest extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Site.
8. Changes to These Terms
We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. We will post the new version on this page with an updated “Last updated” date. Your continued use of the Site after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
9. Contact Us
